title: Readings from Harold Speed
content: When I was just starting out on my journey to learn about painting, I recorded some readings from books that inspired me. I'm just starting to post these readings in mySubstackarchive.Painting by Harold SpeedThe readings are from Harold Speed’s 1924 bookOil Painting Techniques and Materials, originally titledThe Science and Practice of Painting.You can hear the readings atthis Substack post.
